turns.partnerZH: 我在哪里可以核对卡上的姓名？
turns.reply: At the desk near the entrance.

bridge.text: Will this country accept my teaching credential?
bridge.translation: 这个国家认可我的教师资格证吗？

title: 让影像投在墙上
guide: ject 有投、扔的意思。把光向前投到墙上，就有了投影。
scene: 酒店在院子里放露天电影。

dialogue.text: Where will you project the film?
dialogue.translation: 你们会把电影投到哪里？

dialogue.text: The projector will point at that wall.

turns.partner: Where will you project the film?
turns.partnerZH: 你们会把电影投到哪里？
turns.reply: The projector will point at that wall.

turns.partner: Where should we sit to see it clearly?
turns.reply: Near the middle, two rows back.

bridge.text: Can you project the picture onto the wall?
bridge.translation: 能把这张图片投到墙上吗？

title: 多住一晚
guide: tend 有伸展的意思。时间往后伸，就能多住一天。
scene: 你想把住宿延长到周日。

dialogue.text: Can I extend my stay by one night?
Yes. I'll arrange the extension.

turns.partner: Can I extend my stay by one night?
turns.reply: Yes. I'll arrange the extension.

turns.partner: Would you like to keep the same room?
turns.partnerZH: 你想继续住原来那间吗？
turns.reply: Yes, if the price is the same.

bridge.text: Could you extend my stay till Friday?

title: 为迟到道歉
guide: apology 是一句道歉。换词尾，就能说出道歉这个动作或态度。
scene: 因为公交晚点，你迟到了几分钟。

dialogue.text: I apologize for being late.
Thank you for the apology. We can still catch the boat.
dialogue.translation: 谢谢你道歉，我们还赶得上船。

turns.partner: I apologize for being late.
turns.reply: Thank you for the apology. We can still catch the boat.
turns.replyZH: 谢谢你道歉，我们还赶得上船。

turns.partner: How soon can you get to the harbor?
turns.reply: In ten minutes. Thank you for waiting.
turns.replyZH: 十分钟后到。谢谢你等我。

bridge.text: I regret my words. Please accept my apology.
bridge.translation: 我后悔说了那样的话，请接受我的道歉。
